answer_1.quote: We propose a code model COM-MIT ... and implement COMMIT using CodeT5+ as the backbone model that is trained on CODEC. ... generate commit messages.

answer_2.quote: Common evaluation metrics used for generation tasks include BLEU , METEOR  and ROUGE ... we use BLEU-4 (B-4), METEOR (M) and ROUGE-L (R-L).

answer_4.quote: we first randomly select 300 samples from the test set. Then, we ask two coders to independently review each Diff and select only one commit message, which fits the code difference best, out of the 7 candidates.
answer_4.guideline: Coders were asked to select the commit message that fits the code difference best among the candidate messages.
